label: Structured W256 self-attention - 2x1s input/output x59 - residual hindsight S1 x59 + R128 reset each second - layer2 hidden512 then stream-only layer13 hidden512 - independent weights shared across forecast steps - corr-gated variance +0.01 - train256k - equal batch10240 - EMA4

architecture.numberedLayerSharing: Layer2 and layer13 have independent weights, each shared only across forecast seconds. Layer12 is the shared learned register initializer reset per output second. All other numbered-layer sharing is unchanged.
architecture.initialState: the first observed W embedding seeds M and P with two unnumbered GNGLUs; shared layer 3 produces F and shared layer 4 produces PF
architecture.outputState: Layer8 emits W256. Each predicted second initializes z0=concat(learned R128, matching noisy O59 sample). Layer2 maps concat(W256,z0,variance), 444 inputs through hidden512 to a 187-coordinate residual, yielding z1=z0+delta2. Independently learned layer13 maps z1 ALONE, 187 inputs through hidden512 to a 187-coordinate residual, yielding z2=z1+delta13. Emit z2[128:]. Layer13 sees no direct feature embedding, variance or fresh hindsight input. Both layers share weights across forecast seconds. Reset registers and sample before the next forecast second; no hindsight feedback into structured recurrence.
architecture.latentSemantics: P, F, PF, and NF remain unconstrained latent embeddings in this experiment; no probability decoder or density loss is imposed

hindsightConditioning.source: Each predicted second independently concatenates the same learned R128 initial vector with its one noisy standardized O59 hindsight sample; scalar variance conditions only layer 2.
hindsightConditioning.readout: z0=concat(layer12,noisy_features); z1=z0+layer2(concat(expected_W,z0,variance)); z2=z1+layer13(z1); output=z2[128:]. Layer2 and layer13 have independent weights, each reused across forecast seconds. No direct W/variance input to layer13. Full gradients through z1, reset stream for next second.
hindsightConditioning.initialization: Learned layer12 initialized to zeros. Layer2 and layer13 independently initialized; both final projections start at rectangular identity*0.001, bias zero. Literal unit residual additions. Existing backbone/first readout initialization order and seed are unchanged.

loss.description: mean MSE over both predicted output steps and all 59 feature channels after per-feature training-split standardization

hindsightNoiseSchedule.advance: check once after each complete epoch; if threshold met, increment variance once for the next epoch, capped at 1; otherwise hold indefinitely within the run epoch budget
hindsightNoiseSchedule.prediction: clean standardized features in one forward: conditioned layer2 residual followed by stream-only layer13 residual, no extra noise draw or noise-level update inside the readout

sampling.description: original dense chronological clean-origin dataset with exact-zero next-return targets excluded
sampling.comparisonControl: Start fresh after predecessor completes 128 epochs. Replace its second independent layer2 readout with independently learned stream-only layer13, keeping hidden width 512. All other dataset, dimensions, initialization, optimizer, MSE, batch, EMA, noise gate and evaluation settings unchanged.

evaluation.headline: step-1 next completed 1s signed log return
evaluation.checkpointSelection: pure-noise validation step-1 next-return MSE and correlation; test never selects
evaluation.hindsight: All forecast evaluations use variance 1 and fixed split-specific Gaussian streams independent of targets. The training-only current-noise reconstruction probe controls the curriculum. A separate current-noise validation reconstruction diagnostic uses raw weights and a distinct seed; it does not affect the curriculum, loss, or checkpoint selection.

alignment.input: two consecutive timeline rows ending at each clean example origin
alignment.target: the two complete chronological timeline rows at origin+1 and origin+2
alignment.futureExtension: K1 uses consecutive rows ending at origin; K2 uses consecutive rows starting at origin+1
alignment.attentionCausality: output step s attends only to generated NF states at output steps <= s
alignment.hindsight: Each output step independently resets registers to the same learned layer12 vector and uses only its matching noisy O59 row. Neither updated registers nor samples carry to another output step or change W/M/P/F/PF/NF trajectories.
